# Cook Keeper

> Cook Keeper is a fan-made tool for the game Core Keeper that helps players find cooking pot recipes by buff and preview the result of combining any two ingredients.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Filter every Core Keeper cooking pot ingredient by the buffs you want, or combine two ingredients to preview the cooked dish and its effects.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Recent updates, new features, and fixes for Cook Keeper.
